title: UnpluGMail change-email directory
description: One file holding every entry. Same format as addon/lib/directory.json in the UnpluGMail add-on, plus the sample fields category, checked_how and time_minutes.

name.description: Service name as people know it.

domains.description: Web addresses the service uses for its site and its emails.

category.description: shopping, bank, telecom, insurance, government, travel, platform, ...

change_email_url.description: Direct link to the page where you change your email. Leave out if there is none.

help_url.description: The service's own help article about changing the email.

change_email.description: self = you can change it yourself on a page. support = only by contacting support (form, chat, letter, phone). none = the email cannot be changed (new account needed). unknown = could not find out.

needs_password.description: Does the change ask for your current password?

checked_how.description: own_account = seen while logged in. help_page = taken from the service's official help pages only.

time_minutes.description: Minutes for an ordinary person, without AI, from the service's home page to the change-email step (login included).

time_source.description: measured = timed by a person doing it. estimated = estimated from the documented steps.

notes.description: Short plain-English tip, e.g. 'Under Mein Konto (My account) > Persönliche Daten (Personal data)'.

offered.description: Is there a 'Sign in with Google' button?

password_possible.description: Can a Google sign-in account add its own password?

email_changeable.description: Can a Google sign-in account change its email?

tested_result.description: After the Google account's address changed, did the site keep the account or make a new one?
